A1.justification: Both PDFs describe MeanFuser and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and supplementary Sections 7–8. All material can be reliably matched across versions.

before.justification: v1 reports original NAVSIM evaluations, component ablations, and CARLA Longest6 experiments, including repeated-run results in supplementary Table 5.

after.justification: v2 retains the original NAVSIM, CARLA Longest6, ablation, and qualitative results. Retained results still constitute original empirical evidence.

M1.justification: Section 4.1, Figure 3, and Equation 15 remove auxiliary surrounding-agent detection supervision and its loss, retaining mapping supervision. The core GMN, MeanFlow, and ARM procedures remain unchanged. Figure 3 also changes MSE to L1, aligning its label with the L1 loss already specified in v1 Equation 13.

E1.justification: The described auxiliary training tasks narrow from mapping plus surrounding-agent detection to mapping alone. Dataset and driving-evaluation coverage remain NAVSIMv1, NAVSIMv2, and CARLA Longest6, with the same supplementary scenarios.

E2.justification: Table 1 removes PARADrive and adds World4Drive to the NAVSIMv1 comparison. Table 2 removes ARTEMIS from NAVSIMv2. The remaining comparison sets, including supplementary benchmarks, are retained.

E3.justification: Table 1 changes the reported inputs for UniAD and Epona from camera plus LiDAR to camera only, while retaining their backbones and scores. These are reported setting revisions; the PDFs do not establish reruns. Splits, metrics, optimization settings, and trajectory horizons remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Table 4 retains the component, proposal-averaging, and failure-coverage analyses. Supplementary Tables 6–8 retain the Gaussian-component-count, GMN-construction, and multimodality ablations. The qualitative cases are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report three runs per CARLA route with means and standard deviations in Table 5. Table 3 retains median inference speed over multiple runs. No seed, interval, significance-testing, or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Table 2 revises DiffusionDrive's EPDMS from 88.1 to 88.3 and updates DAC, DDC, TTC, LK, and EC. World4Drive's 85.1 PDMS is added; PARADrive's 84.0 PDMS and ARTEMIS's 83.1 EPDMS entries are removed. MeanFuser's scores, efficiency results, and supplementary results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equation 15 revises the formal total-loss definition by removing the weighted detection term, leaving three components instead of four. The MeanFlow derivation, GMN definitions, and supplementary diversity metrics remain unchanged; no theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: anchor-independent GMN sampling, one-step MeanFlow planning, and adaptive trajectory reconstruction. The novelty, efficiency, and superior NAVSIM-performance claims retain their scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning trajectory coverage, differentiated driving styles, ARM's handling of suboptimal proposals, and data starvation with excessive Gaussian components remain unchanged. No substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added or removed.

D1.justification: v1 explicitly states that code and model are available; v2's footnote mentions only code at the same repository. This narrows the documented availability statement without establishing that model access actually changed. Other implementation and hardware disclosures remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds seven cited works, including consistency-policy papers, ConRFT, WorldRFT, World4Drive, and PlanAgent, and removes ARTEMIS and Trajectory-guided Control Prediction. These are localized citation changes; the substantive research positioning remains largely unchanged. VADv2's publication update represents the same work.

P1.justification: Changes include author reordering, limited abstract punctuation edits, and replacement of the internship footnote with funding and code information. Most prose and the section sequence remain intact, without extensive rewriting or narrative reorganization.

P2.justification: Figure 3 updates its decoder and loss labels and associated caption. Tables 1–2 change row membership, and Table 1 reorders camera-only comparators. Figure sizing and text placement shift modestly; the supplementary displays remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Figure 3's L1 label resolves a concrete inconsistency with Equation 13, and Table 1 makes camera-only comparisons more explicit. These provide modest reporting improvements, while the central empirical evidence remains unchanged. Removed baseline entries and the narrower model-availability disclosure limit the gain; the revised auxiliary objective does not establish better performance.
